can_do_statement: Can use the irregular superlative adjective 'best' in the phrase 'my best friend'.

ontology.mental_model: one person crowned as top member of a set by the speaker
ontology.agency_or_distance: possessive anchors the ranking to the speaker's own world

positives: She's my best friend.
Marco has been my best friend since primary school.
negatives: I always try to do my best.
This is the best pizza in town.

can_do_statement: Can form a limited range of complex noun phrases with a superlative adjective  + prepositional phrase, to talk about something unique.

ontology.mental_model: a superlative plus a set-specifier phrase carves out the single unique member
ontology.pedagogical_hook: name the thing, then name the world it beats
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker positions an entity as one-of-everything

positives: It is the biggest zoo in the world.
They were the happiest days of my life.
negatives: It's just the best.
The room was the biggest.

can_do_statement: Can use a limited range of prepositional phrases with 'of' after a superlative adjective, to refer to one thing within a set or part of a set.

ontology.mental_model: 'of' names the set from which the ranked member is drawn
ontology.pedagogical_hook: best of WHAT? - of names the pile
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker picks one thing out of a stated set

positives: My teacher said that it was the best project of all.
I learned to surf, this was the best part of the trip.
negatives: It's the biggest room in the house.
It was the best day ever.

can_do_statement: Can use prepositional phrases with 'in' + singular name of a place after a superlative adjective.

ontology.mental_model: 'in' names the spatial container that bounds the comparison set
ontology.pedagogical_hook: biggest WHERE? - in names the place
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker locates the top-ranked thing inside a place

positives: It's the biggest room in the house.
I bought them because they are the cheapest clothes in the shop.
negatives: You will miss the best party of the year!
The keys are in the house.

can_do_statement: Can form superlative adjectives using the '-est' suffix, with adjectives of one syllable, and with two-syllable adjectives ending in -y.

ontology.mental_model: the -est / -iest suffix stamps a word as rank-one on a scale
ontology.pedagogical_hook: y becomes i before you crown it
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker grades things to the top rung

positives: The easiest way to get to my house is by Underground.
You are the funniest person that I have ever seen!
negatives: This phone is bigger than my old one.
It's the most comfortable chair in the house.

can_do_statement: Can form a noun phrase with 'my' or 'your' + superlative adjective + noun, with a limited range of nouns and contexts.

ontology.mental_model: a possessive determiner hands the top rank to a person
ontology.agency_or_distance: possessive ties the superlative to an involved party

positives: I bought these clothes for my youngest brother.
Please wear your oldest clothes.
negatives: It has the latest technology.
My brother is the oldest in our family.

can_do_statement: Can form superlative adjectives with adjectives of one syllable with a short vowel, by doubling the final consonant and adding '–est'.

ontology.mental_model: short-vowel words double their last consonant before taking the crown
ontology.pedagogical_hook: big -> bigger -> the BIGGEST - hold the consonant
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker marks top rank with doubled-consonant spelling

positives: It's the biggest and oldest museum in Libya.
Today was the hottest day of the entire summer.
negatives: It was the cheapest in this shop!
She's the funniest person I know.

can_do_statement: Can form a noun phrase with 'the' + superlative adjective + noun.

ontology.mental_model: 'the' plus a -est adjective flags exactly one noun as peak of its kind
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker presents the ranking as given, unique

positives: It has the latest technology.
The best place to visit is La Baule.
negatives: My youngest brother helped me with the boxes.
The zoo was big and the aquarium was bigger.

can_do_statement: Can form superlative adjectives using the suffix '-st' to adjectives ending in '–e'.

ontology.mental_model: words already ending in e just add -st to reach top rank
ontology.pedagogical_hook: late -> the latest: keep the e, add -st
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker grades to the extreme using e-final stems

positives: I always watch the latest music videos from there.
But the nicest thing at my party was my presents.
negatives: It's the biggest room in the house.
He was the tallest player on the team.

can_do_statement: Can form superlative adjectives by adding the suffix '-est', to adjectives of one syllable.

ontology.mental_model: a one-syllable adjective bolts -est on the end to claim top rank
ontology.agency_or_distance: speaker asserts an absolute peak on a scale

positives: It was the cheapest in this shop!
He is the oldest of the three brothers.
negatives: The easiest way to get to my house is by Underground.
You are the funniest person that I have ever seen!
